59b4660c9819d21d97621fadcac9e93be556164c.summary: Google Threat Intelligence Group and Mandiant report BRICKSTORM, a Go-based backdoor used in an espionage campaign against US legal, SaaS, BPO and technology organisations since March 2025. The activity is attributed to UNC5221 and closely related, suspected China-nexus clusters. The actor deploys the backdoor on network appliances that lack endpoint detection, targets VMware vCenter, clones sensitive virtual machines, and reads mailboxes through Microsoft Entra ID enterprise applications. Average dwell time was 393 days. The report gives hunting guidance and YARA rules.
